run_pyr_depth_bilinear: run pyr_depth on a PyTorch depth tensor using bilinear average pooling with a given kernel size
run_pyr_depth_masked_bilinear: run pyr_depth with masked_bilinear mode to safely downsample depth tensors containing NaN values
run_pyr_depth_max_min: run pyr_depth using max or min pooling mode to downsample a depth tensor by kernel size
run_resize_depth: run resize_depth to bilinearly or nearest-neighbor resize a PyTorch depth tensor to a target size
run_resize_depth_factor2: run resize_depth_factor2 to downsample a depth tensor by a power-of-two factor using bilinear, nearest, max, or min mode
